Explorations in **interesting mathematical theorems**.

My goal is to make mathematical ideas approachable
without sacrificing the details and subtleties that
make them interesting.

Some articles are introductory, while others explore
more advanced topics. Whenever possible, I will
highlight the necessary prerequisites and provide
references for further reading.
